description: This file contains a unit test class 'DataGroupServiceTest' for testing the 'DataGroupService' class within the OrangeHRM project, focused on authorization data management functionalities.

classes.name: DataGroupServiceTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case class for testing the DataGroupService, covering various methods including permission retrieval and collection, ensuring correct behavior and data handling.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test case with a new instance of DataGroupService before each test.

methods.name: testGetDataGroupPermission
methods.description: Tests fetching data group permission for specific role and data group ID.

methods.name: testGetDataGroups
methods.description: Tests retrieving a list of data groups, expecting an empty list in this mock scenario.

methods.name: testGetDataGroup
methods.description: Tests fetching a single data group by identifier and verifying its permission properties.

methods.name: testGetDataGroupPermissionCollectionWithOnlyOnePermissionForDataGroup
methods.description: Tests collection of permissions when only one permission exists for a data group, and the collection is properly summarized.

methods.name: testGetDataGroupPermissionCollectionWithTwoPermissionsForDataGroup
methods.description: Tests merging permissions from two permission entries for the same data group, verifying combined permission logic.

methods.name: testGetDataGroupPermissionCollectionWithMultiplePermissionsForDataGroup
methods.description: Tests merging multiple permissions, including different data groups, verifying the correct aggregated output.
